answer: Per-action compute stamps: every answer or attestation must carry a fresh proof of work, and its difficulty rises with how many actions the network saw from new accounts this epoch. One honest agent pays a few cents of compute a day, but a sybil farm of ten thousand accounts pays ten thousand times over, and the bill climbs as its own tide of fakes raises difficulty. Old votes can't be replayed like a relic, and no farm can camp on a knoll of free actions.
